known_good_maf_swap.detail: With a known-good MAF installed, short-term fuel trim drops to +0.8% within 30 seconds. Long-term trim begins learning down. Confirms the original MAF is the fault source.

vacuum_leak_smoke.detail: Smoke machine pressurized intake to 15 in-Hg. No visible smoke escape from any hose, gasket, or fitting. Rules out vacuum leak as primary cause.

fuel_pressure_test.detail: Fuel pressure within spec at idle and under load. Fuel pump and regulator operating correctly.
